# Audit API

2 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/audit`

List audit entries

List audit log entries, newest first (admin only). Two paging modes: offset paging (`page`/`per_page`, the default) and keyset paging (`cursor`). Keyset paging never counts rows or scans past an offset, so it stays fast on large tables; follow `next_cursor` while `has_more` is true. In offset mode `total` is exact when `total_exact` is true (small tables and the last page); otherwise it is the planner's row estimate (no filter) or a lower bound (with `actor`/`action` filters).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | query | integer | no | 1-based page number (offset paging). Ignored when `cursor` is present. Minimum: 1. |
| `per_page` | query | integer | no | Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no | Opaque `next_cursor` of the previous page. Present but empty starts keyset paging at the newest entry. Selects keyset paging: the response carries no `page`, `total` or `total_exact`. |
| `actor` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the actor name or actor id. |
| `action` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the action name. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Paginated list of audit entries | `application/json`: object |
| `400` | Malformed cursor | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [AuditEntry](schemas.md#auditentry) | no | - |
| `has_more` | boolean | no | True when entries follow this page. |
| `next_cursor` | string | no | Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Absent when `has_more` is false. |
| `page` | integer | no | Offset paging only. |
| `per_page` | integer | no | - |
| `total` | integer | no | Offset paging only. See `total_exact`. |
| `total_exact` | boolean | no | Offset paging only. False when `total` is an estimate or a lower bound. |

### `GET /api/v1/admin/audit/export`

Export audit log

Export the audit log as JSONL or CSV (admin only). Streams the log as a download without counting rows: entries are read in keyset pages (newest first) and flushed after every page, so memory stays bounded however long the log is. The body is chunked (no `Content-Length`); if the server fails after the response started the connection is aborted rather than ended normally, so a truncated file is detectable. In CSV, cells starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tab or CR are prefixed with `'` to defuse spreadsheet formula injection. Fields (stable; new fields may be appended): `id`, `timestamp` (RFC 3339, UTC), `action`, `actor`, `actor_type`, `actor_id`, `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `repository_id`, `project_id`, `ip`, `details` (JSON object; in CSV its JSON text). Unset values are `null` in JSONL and empty in CSV.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | query | string | no | `jsonl` (default): one JSON object per line. `csv`: header row plus one record per entry. One of: `jsonl`, `csv`. Default: `jsonl`. |
| `since` | query | string | no | Only entries at or after this instant: RFC 3339 timestamp or `YYYY-MM-DD` (00:00 UTC). |
| `until` | query | string | no | Only entries strictly before this instant (same forms as `since`); must be after `since`. |
| `actor` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the actor name or actor id. |
| `action` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the action name. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Audit export stream Headers: `Content-Disposition`. | `application/x-ndjson`: string; `text/csv`: string |
| `400` | Unknown `format`, malformed `since`/`until`, or `since` not before `until` | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
